The reference text is "(v. נְגִיד I, 3) prolongation, with רוחא forbearance": it names a SENSE 3, and N00152 has exactly one sense and glosses 'leader, ruler'. N00154 (headword נְגִיד, whose sibling is נְגִיד ², i.e. print's נְגִיד I/II) carries sense —3) "(with רוּחָא; interchanging with נְגִיר) long-suffering, forbearing" — a verbatim match for both the section number and the gloss. Display vocalization נְגִיד is itself a corpus headword (N00154), and the skeleton נגיד is shared by four headwords, so the narrowed niqqud carve-out cannot apply; the niqqud-twin-target hint is ACCEPTED. Target should be N00154 ("Jastrow, נְגִיד 1"); those bytes are not present in the entry, so no patch.

Class 8 sub-token loss: the quotation האי נגיפה נ׳היא has no space after the geresh abbreviation — print reads נ׳ היא. Corpus control: 26,566 occurrences of geresh-followed-by-space against 23 of geresh-followed-immediately-by-a-Hebrew-letter, so the space is the corpus norm and this is a transcription loss, not a print convention. Restoring it needs a byte that `replace` may not introduce (the space is not inside any candidate find-string), so needs_print_check.

Class 11 wrong-link-target in sense —2): the display נ׳ in "—[In later Hebrew: נ׳ accent.]" is a one-letter geresh abbreviation of THIS entry's headword נְגִינָה (n'ginah = accent), but its data-ref is "Jastrow, נ׳ 1" — the article on the letter Nun as a numeral. This is the catalogued geresh-letter-numeral-mislink family (608 corpus-wide), reported here because it is a genuine wrong destination and is not on the v4 script-slated list; correct bytes are absent, so no patch.
